"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for choice-based, parent-driven accountability at every stage of schooling.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Affirmation of higher expectations for all students.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Rejection of the crippling bigotry of low expectations.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Rejection of excessive testing and \"teaching to the test\".",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for strong assessments as a tool for teachers to tailor teaching to meet student needs.",
